name: Standing barbell overhead press
definition: Stand with a barbell held in front of the shoulders in a pronated grip. Press the bar overhead without a deliberate knee drive, then return to the shoulders.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand with a barbell held in front of the shoulders in a pronated grip.
value.movement: Press the bar overhead without a deliberate knee drive, then return to the shoulders.
value.finish: Finish at the original shoulder-height holding position.
value.range_of_motion: Shoulder-height to overhead endpoint; record grip and repeatable overhead position.
